title: geum donianum
intro: Geum donianum, commonly known as the alpine avens, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Geum donianum include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Geum donianum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
